llm_response.reason: The website handles an extremely broad range of unrelated products with unusually low prices and popular brand names, but fails to provide any verifiable company information, contact details, or an appropriate privacy policy. Payment methods include high-risk options (bank transfer/convenience store payments). The site uses urgency-based language and does not display signs of a legitimate business (no address, no owner, no detailed company data). The subdomain structure and domain provider are popular with anonymous and transient scam shops. All of these are classic signals of a fake online shopping scam.
